Bullish options flow and institutional accumulation align with +4.5% 1M momentum, while a reasonable 1.7x P/S provides valuation support in a risk-off tape (VIX 27.99). Backlog visibility and defensive cash flows make this an ideal flight-to-quality name.

NOC owns the B-21 Raider stealth bomber program and Sentinel ICBM modernization — two of the largest, longest-duration defense programs in the pipeline, offering differentiated exposure vs. LMT's tactical focus. Strong +6.5% 1M momentum with institutional bullish positioning suggests smart money is front-running FY27 appropriations. Nuclear triad modernization is politically bulletproof across administrations.

HII is the sole builder of US nuclear-powered aircraft carriers and one of two submarine builders, giving it a monopoly position as Navy shipbuilding budgets accelerate under the Indo-Pacific pivot and AUKUS commitments. The 0.8x P/S is a deep discount to primes despite +6.4% 1M momentum and bullish institutional flow, reflecting a re-rating as margin headwinds abate. Diversifies the defense basket into naval/shipbuilding sub-niche.

SMCI is the leading AI server/liquid-cooling rack provider tied directly to NVDA GB200/GB300 shipments, with a rock-bottom 0.3x P/S after the -24.8% 1M drawdown reflecting governance overhang and margin compression.
